Superscript rendered with caret symbol

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import convert, ConversionOptions

def main() -> None:
    html = "<p>x<sup>2</sup></p>"
    options = ConversionOptions(sup_symbol="^")
    result = convert(html, options)
    print(result.content)

main()
```
